svg.title: FTF-01 Scene 91 - 강에서 바다까지 푸른 내일을 지키다
svg.desc: Approved FTF cinematic manga scene 91. Four illustrated panels: upstream river cleanup, estuary trash interception system installation, community reuse action, and restored marine life. Korean, Chinese and English captions with comic sound effects. Embedded raster artwork; not a placeholder.
